Message:
drbd: prepare for more than 32 bit flags

 - struct drbd_conf { ... unsigned long flags; ... }
 + struct drbd_conf { ... unsigned long drbd_flags[N]; ... }

And introduce wrapper functions for test/set/clear bit operations
on this member.
